introduction_markdown: CAMEROON GENERAL CERTIFICATE OF EDUCATION BOARD, General Certificate of Education Examination, June 2020, Ordinary Level, Additional Mathematics, Paper 2 (0575). Time allowed: two and a half hours. Answer ALL QUESTIONS IN SECTION A and ANY TWO QUESTIONS FROM EITHER SECTION B or SECTION C. IN SECTIONS B AND C, ALL QUESTIONS CARRY EQUAL MARKS. Candidates are expected to answer a combination of Section A and Section B OR Section A and Section C but NOT a combination of all three. Section A: Pure Mathematics (compulsory, answer all questions). Section B: Mechanics (if this section is chosen, then Section C may not be chosen; answer any two questions). Section C: Statistics and Probability (if this section is chosen, then Section B may not be chosen; answer any two questions). All necessary working must be shown. No marks will be awarded for answers without brief statements showing how the answers have been obtained. Electronic calculators may be used. Where necessary take g as 10 m s^-2. Formulae Booklets may be used.
enonce_intro_markdown:
Yang takes a loan of 1,000,000 FCFA from a credit union. The loan is to be paid in ten months in equal instalments with an interest rate of 1.5 % of what he owes for that month.

The table below shows how the repayment of the loan is schedule for the first 3 months

| Month | Capital | Repayment | Interest | Total amount paid back to the credit union |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 1000000 | 100000 | 15000 | 115000 |
| 2 | 900000 | 100000 | 13500 | 113500 |
| 3 | 800000 | 100000 | 12000 | 112000 |

questions.enonce_markdown:
Find,

(a) the interest paid in the $10^{\text{th}}$ month, *[3 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Each month $100\,000$ FCFA of the capital is repaid, so the capital owed at the start of month $n$ is $1\,000\,000-100\,000(n-1)$. In month $10$:

$$\text{capital}=1\,000\,000-9\times100\,000=100\,000\text{ FCFA}.$$

Interest in month $10=1.5\%$ of $100\,000=0.015\times100\,000=1\,500$ FCFA.

(Check with the progression of the interest column: $15\,000,\,13\,500,\,12\,000,\dots$ is an arithmetic progression with $a=15\,000$ and $d=-1\,500$, so $T_{10}=15\,000+9(-1\,500)=1\,500$.)

**Interest in the $10^{\text{th}}$ month $=1\,500$ FCFA.**

questions.enonce_markdown: (b) the total interest paid for the 10 months *[3 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
The monthly interests form an arithmetic progression with first term $a=15\,000$, common difference $d=-1\,500$ and $n=10$ terms, last term $l=1\,500$.

$$S_{10}=\frac{n}{2}(a+l)=\frac{10}{2}(15\,000+1\,500)=5\times16\,500=82\,500.$$

(Same result with the formula $S_n=\frac n2\,[2a+(n-1)d]=5[30\,000-13\,500]=82\,500$.)

**Total interest $=82\,500$ FCFA.**

questions.enonce_markdown: (c) the total amount of money paid back to the credit union. *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Total paid back = capital borrowed + total interest

$$=1\,000\,000+82\,500=1\,082\,500\text{ FCFA}.$$

(Check: $10\times100\,000+82\,500=1\,082\,500$.)

**The credit union receives $1\,082\,500$ FCFA in all.**
